paragraphs.text: The Mogg Hollows were a breeding ground for the moggs of Rath , which was planeshifted to Dominaria during the Rathi Overlay .
Mogg Hollows was part of the open-air Flowstone Desert of Rath , and was composed to a series of shallow basins, cliffs and rock formations.
During the Rathi Overlay , Mogg Hollows was shifted to Dominaria , but it is not known where it ended up or if it was destroyed in the process.
